overview: Helen's husband suddenly stops communicating with her but continues to send support to his family. Helen then decides to go to Dubai to look for her husband, finding support and help from her friends Joy, Lawrence, Margot, Homer, and Reggie who are working in Dubai. The group's journey in searching for Helen's missing husband also serves as a journey to self-discovery, acceptance, and freedom from the personal burdens that they carry in their hearts.
title: Hinahanap-hanap Kita

overview: An anthology of different narratives of hugot-inspired shorts that mirrors our experiences with falling in love.
title: Ampalaya Chronicles

overview: "Krychowiak: One Step from the Top" isn't a football documentary. It's pure entertainment, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in the world of Grzegorz Krychowiak and his wife, French model and bodybuilder Celia Jaunat. Renowned for his sense of humor and passion for fashion, the athlete has made 100 appearances for the Polish national team. However, for Krychowiak, a football career was just one of many dreams he boldly pursued, never looking back and living life to the fullest. In this documentary, dedicated to his life with Celia, the camera follows him as he pursues his goals, both professional and personal.
title: Krychowiak: krok od szczytu

overview: Music educator and pro musician Marty Schwartz talks with experts about the science of how music affects our emotions, brains, and bodies.
title: Science of Sound

overview: Manimal centers on the character Dr. Jonathan Chase, a shape-shifting man who possessed the ability to turn himself into any animal he chose. He used this ability to help the police solve crimes.
title: Manimal

overview: A talent show founded by the Dutch television host, Albert Verlinde
title: My Name Is ...

overview: Rock Nation, a program in which Edwin Jansen and Dennis Weening wanted to form a rock band with twenty musicians.
title: Rock Nation

overview: 24 uur met... is a Dutch talkshow where the host stays for 24 hours with a guest in a small one-room studio. During these 24 hours they can't leave the studio.
title: 24 uur met...

overview: Brian Lohnes heads to dragstrips, off-road courses, road circuits and beyond to show you some of the most interesting motorsports on earth. He sets up match races where he compels racers to let it all hang out for a $10,000 prize.
title: Put Up Or Shut Up

overview: A young woman, Yubirí, seeks success in her career and in love. A fortune teller tells her that she will meet her beloved; that same night she meets Wilker, a young singer, and Juan Diego.
title: Guerra de mujeres

overview: A broken love, suspended in time. Deep secrets hidden and a colossal lie engulfing them all. Fernanda has been married for twenty years to a man who has made her unhappy. But Pablo, her great love from her youth, whom she believes to be dead, is alive. He has spent twenty years in a hell behind bars, accused of a terrible crime. This is a contemporary story, a story of love fraught with impossibilities, a story of a truth that has always been hidden. It's the story of any woman in love, because when you love... love drives you mad.
title: El amor las vuelve locas

overview: Documentary series on the fall of the Iron Curtain and its legacy. 1989 marked the collapse of communism in Eastern and Central Europe and an end to a way of life for millions of people. Having lived through extraordinary times, they tell their stories of life behind the Iron Curtain, looking beyond the headlines of spies and surveillance, secret police and political repression, to reveal a rich tapestry of experience.
title: The Lost World of Communism

overview: The story of the series will revolve around three families–the Villarazon, De La Costa, and Abrigo– and who is worthy of being the heir to Aurea De La Costa's company.
title: Shining Inheritance

overview: Alejandro falls in love with Mariana, but he doesn't know how to approach her, so he starts sending her love letters. Mariana immediately falls for a mysterious author of romantic letters. The only person who knows the real author of those letters is Oscar, Alejandro's best friend, who takes advantage of the situation and wins Mariana over behind Alejandro's back, telling her that he was the one who sent the letters. Mariana is confused, since something about Oscar's personality tells her he couldn't have written those letters. And Alejandro still doesn't have the courage to confess the truth.
title: Romántica Obsesión

overview: An army veteran lures a young student into a dark, twisted friendship in this chilling drama about a massacre in '80s Bogotá, inspired by real events.
title: Estado de fuga 1986

overview: At the heart of five primary forests, from the Amazon to Oceania via Africa, five representatives of indigenous communities are committed to protecting these green lungs: reforesting, fighting pollution, preserving biodiversity. Through their sensitive gaze, this documentary series invites us to rediscover their vision of the world.
title: Gardiens de la forêt

overview: Lukas, a former mercenary haunted by PTSD, roams the city as a waste picker with his trolley. At the homeless shelter where he lives, he salvages scraps to help others. Using his metalworking skill, he crafts statues and sells them to raise funds, quietly battling the violent past he longs to escape.
title: The Nowhere Man

overview: In the shadows of history, a secret beats like a pulse. Two vampire sisters survive a shortage of "clean human blood" during the Black Death, but the true poison is the silence that surrounds them. Centuries later, one of their descendants faces the same conflict during the AIDS pandemic in Spain and discovers that social condemnation has not changed. Love between the "sick" and the "healthy," between humans and vampires, still inspires the same terror. What happens when eternity is measured in centuries of silence?
title: Silencio

overview: Project Runway: Threads is a competition series showcasing America's most talented young fashion designers. Each week, three new contestants pull out their scissors, sketchbooks and skills to see who can out-design the competition and set the new standard for the future of fashion. Challenges will be fast-paced, unpredictable and far from child's play as these nascent fashion powerhouses compete for $10,000 to be used at any Jo-Ann Fabrics and Crafts Store or Joann.com, a prestigious scholarship to the summer program at FIDM including travel expenses and a top-of-the-line sewing and embroidery studio courtesy of Brother International Corporation.
title: Project Runway: Threads

overview: People of Earth is a new original comedy about a support group for alien abductees. The show centers on skeptical journalist Ozzie Graham, who investigates a support group to write about the members' supposed alien encounters. The more he digs into their oddball claims, the more he realizes there is truth in their stories and possibly even signs that point to his own alien abduction. The onetime outsider now finds himself a part of this eclectic group of misfits, all the while struggling with the idea of knowing that life could exist beyond our world.
title: People of Earth

overview: Teen prodigy Lin Dongfeng and wealthy heiress Zheng Wanzhi are a campus couple trying to avoid the cliché of breaking up after graduation. At the same time, Lin receives an unexpected invitation from Gu Binqing, head of domestic tech giant Huasheng Group. While he hesitates, a comment he posts online about controlled nuclear fusion draws intense national and international attention. Renowned physicist Wu Wenyong recognizes Lin's extraordinary talent, and under the leadership of Minister Yang Zhengdao, a "Chasing the Sun" task force is formed, with Lin appointed as its lead. As they push through multiple phases of fusion research, Lin faces mounting challenges—from rivals attempting to steal breakthroughs, to emotional dilemmas, to internal scrutiny and political pressure—testing both his scientific vision and his resolve.
title: Genesis

overview: Mysterious mirages frequently appear above Dengzhou City. Zeng Qian, a female bounty hunter escorting a prisoner with her younger brother Zeng Xin, is unexpectedly drawn into a dangerous upheaval after tearing down the wanted poster of the vigilante thief known as Nightshade. As strange incidents plague the city—civilians vanish without explanation, mirages descend to the ground only to rise again, and an iron-armored giant suddenly emerges—Zeng Xin goes missing. In her search for him, Zeng Qian is forced to form an uneasy alliance with Cao Sheng, a brilliant strategist; Nightshade, whose true identity remains a mystery; and Xie Jingtang, an arrogant yet highly skilled warrior. As the group works together, they dismantle misunderstandings and pursue the truth behind the mirages. Caught between kinship, friendship, and a greater moral cause, they must confront unknown forces and uncover the fantastical conspiracy surrounding the illusory city in the sky.
title: The Mirage
De Jeugdkliniek: Als Niets Meer Werkt

overview: Power, money and influence - the monarchy is at the heart of our national life. David Dimbleby takes a personal look at its role and its future in a changing world.
title: What's The Monarchy For?

overview: Inside the police hunt to solve the mystery of the destruction of the Sycamore Gap tree in September 2023 - a crime of extraordinary vandalism that shocked Britain.
title: The Sycamore Gap Tree Mystery

overview: Film critic Ian Nathan presents a series exploring some of our perennial Christmas favourites. Each episode will tell the story of a single film, delving into the trials and triumphs behind it and identifying the ingredients that elevated it from a simple movie to a classic.
title: Classic Christmas Movies

overview: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a football player -- altering both of their fates.
title: No Tail to Tell

overview: Vered is in a 40-year-old crisis - her marriage is boring, work is boring and the house is suffocating. One evening Naomi, her aging mother, declares that she has lost the purpose of life and asks Vered to kill her. Vered does not agree and goes on a wild journey in order to find meaning in both of their lives.
title: A Happy Place

overview: An underqualified Dr. Fredericks does his best to help and therapize struggling couples back to a so-called "safe space."
title: Safe Space

overview: "BACKPACKERS" is the first Zoomer travel show! Eight top bloggers - Amina Tenderlybae, Lesha Younger, Sabina Khairova, Andrey Kokoshka, Katya Adushkina, Dilblin, Dinara Kurbanova and Narek Simonyan will show the coolest places on the planet, and most importantly, they will prove that you can travel with only one backpack and a minimum account balance. The task of the guys is to complete challenges, get money for them, which can be spent on food, lodging or entertainment, and save as much as possible. Whoever has less cash left in the finals will have to experience the main "nightmare of the city".
title: БЭКПЕКЕРЫ

overview: Among Us is a show in which adults try to get lost among children! So that they have at least some chance, all the voices are changed, and the children's eyes are closed. In this issue, Ivan Abramov and Ekaterina Morgunova will try to get into a children's party. Will they be able to, or will they fall for the obvious?
title: СРЕДИ НАС

overview: Meet Wataru, an open book who wears his heart on his sleeve, and Minato, a man who always comes across as cool, calm, and collected. Though they're polar opposites, their shared love of photography brings them together in high school, and they become such good friends that they decide to rent a place together in college. It's only when Minato moves across the country for work after graduation that Wataru realizes he's been harboring romantic feelings for the stoic gentleman this whole time. So when they reunite three years later, Wataru hopes they'll be able to reconnect as friends... but now it's Minato who seems to have his sights set on romance! Friends or lovers - which will they choose? The countdown to their final decision is on!
title: Shinyuu no "Dousei shite" ni "Un" to Iu made

overview: Morning show in which two presenters discuss current affairs with various guests, focusing on politics, economics, security, and Dutch identity.
title: Goedemorgen Nederland

overview: Dunkman with 40 of the top dunkers from around the world competing for a $200,000 prize.
title: Dunkman
Jin Ri Bu Yi Zha Pian Shen Ming

overview: Betrayed by her fiancé at the engagement party, Jiang Nan enters into a marriage of convenience with her ex-boyfriend Fu Jinchuan to jointly fight for the family fortune against the schemes of her cousin Jiang Bei and the Huo family. Through battles over company shares, the murder of her father, and kidnapping crises, she recognizes Jinchuan's deep affection amid their intense push and pull. Ultimately, they expose the mastermind behind the scenes, inherit the Jiang Group, and find true love in each other.
title: Provocative Love

overview: The daughter of a duke, Wenren Ya, falls in love at first sight with the top scorer Lu Chen and pursues him passionately to marry into her family. Lu Chen appears cold but hides a mysterious past, staying in the capital to investigate his adoptive mother's death and royal secrets. To get closer to him, Wenren Ya enters the Nanyong Academy and repeatedly helps Lu Chen when he is framed by the Su family. Their bond grows amidst crises. Though Lu Chen pushes her away due to his vendetta, Wenren Ya stands by him, aiding in uncovering the truth. Eventually, Lu Chen discovers he is a swapped royal heir and, with Wenren Ya, exposes the Su family's plot. He renounces his royal status to marry into Wenren's household. On their wedding day, Su Yingjie causes trouble again but is subdued by Wenren Ya. The story ends with the couple united, looking forward to a bright future together.
title: Love by Force
Zui Hao Bu Yao Xi Huan Wo

overview: Timeless tells the story of a mysterious criminal who steals a secret state-of-the-art time machine, intent on destroying America as we know it by changing the past. The only hope is an unexpected team: a scientist, a soldier and a history professor, who must use the machine's prototype to travel back in time to critical events. While they must make every effort not to affect the past themselves, they must also stay one step ahead of this dangerous fugitive. But can this handpicked team uncover the mystery behind it all and end his destruction before it's too late?
title: Timeless
Fu Gui Bi Ren Zhi Chuan Cheng Tai Nai Bao You Wo
Hide One's Beloved in a Secluded Place

overview: Chris Hayes asks the big questions that keep him up at night. How do we make sense of this unprecedented moment in world history? Why is this (all) happening?
title: Why is This Happening? with Chris Hayes

overview: A look at Earth's most captivating bodies of water.
title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters

overview: Jamie Oliver brings us the Christmas 2025 culinary countdown guaranteed to get us all organised for the most stress-free festive feast ever. No Christmas cooks will be left behind in the kitchen while festive fun is being had, as Jamie shows us how to cook ahead of time in the weeks leading up to the big day - the perfect present to ourselves and others!
title: Jamie's Cook-Ahead Christmas

overview: Two-part documentary exploring one of the strangest cases in modern British history In May 2008.
title: Twisted Sisters: Madness & Manslaughter

overview: Don't Open the Door tells chilling true-crime tales of unsuspecting individuals whose lives are forever altered when a stranger knocks on the door. In a world where danger lurks just beyond the threshold, ordinary people are thrust into nightmares when their unexpected guests reveal malevolent motives. A suburban couple's act of kindness towards a storm-soaked stranger leads to a costly scam. A single mother's trust in a supposed delivery person turns into a hostage situation. A woman's door-to-door evangelism covers up a sinister cult recruitment scheme.
title: Don't Open the Door

overview: Troy Story explores the latest archaeology and science on one of history's most enduring mysteries: did the Trojan War really happen? In 1874 Heinrich Schliemann announced he had found the legendary city of Troy and caused a sensation. His discoveries have been challenged, and yet ushered in a golden age of archaeology. More than 150 years later, what can we now say is the truth behind the myth?
title: Troy Story

overview: Some very special stately homes and two of Britain's top designers come together for some very special Christmas celebrations.
title: A Very British Christmas

overview: Kate and Ed are a recently married couple whose secrets begin to unravel as life chips away at the personas they present. The kicker? The couple's unraveling starts with an intrusive mosquito.
title: Mosquito

overview: Fluctuating between sanity and nonsense, highs and lows, clever and idiotic – Roi Kafri finally makes it to television with a grown up series in which he plays a host of characters in different stories and worlds, overflowing with emotion, an absurd ensemble cast, and a plot that makes even less sense.
title: Yekumot

overview: Yossi Weiss, a recently fired tour guide who, after years of being absent from home, tries to reconnect with his family, especially his daughter Dana, who has special needs.
title: Dad tries his best

overview: The series begins in the shadow of the newly-erected Berlin Wall, as Alec Leamas watches his last agent shot dead by East German sentries. For Leamas, a senior British intelligence officer in Berlin, the Cold War is over. As he faces the prospect of retirement or worse - a desk job - Control offers him a unique opportunity for revenge. Assuming the guise of an embittered and dissolute ex-agent, Leamas is set up to trap Mundt, the deputy director of the East German Intelligence Service, with himself as the bait. In the background is George Smiley, ready to make the game play out just as Control wants.
title: Legacy of Spies

overview: Bring a cozy fireplace right into your living room.
title: Log Fires

overview: Jasmine works as an escort to provide a better life for her and her stepbrother Tufan – and bribe her way onto the heart transplant list.
title: Jasmine

overview: The story follows Malika, a woman who leaves her traditional family life for love, only to find herself trapped in a marriage with Raza, who becomes increasingly possessive and emotionally abusive.
title: Pamaal

overview: Members of the RV community provide an informative look at the lifestyle.
title: The RVers

overview: Explores how young NBA stars and marketing execs drove an explosion in global popularity in sneakers in the 1990s.
title: The Sneaker Boom

overview: Fred Marsac built his life around jazz. He was happy with his family, alongside his wife and two children, Estelle and Sam. When his wife died in a car accident, he disappeared. He entrusted Sam and Estelle to his in-laws, only to reappear four years later. The welcome is frosty. Estelle rejects him, and his in-laws resent him. To redeem himself, Fred accepts a position as a music teacher at a middle school. The principal, Isabelle Martinet, reluctant to integrate him into the teaching staff, assigns him the most difficult class.
title: Fred et son orchestre

overview: Public figures travel the world by train.
title: Great Railway Journeys

overview: Based on the autobiography by Klaus Voormann, Hamburg Days is set in the early 1960s. In the smoke-filled clubs of Hamburg's St. Pauli's red-light district, an inexperienced young rock ‘n' roll band from Liverpool collide with two young artists, Klaus Voormann and Astrid Kirchherr. Together they help spark a transformation that turns a scrappy group of teenagers into the greatest music phenomenon the world has ever known: The Beatles.
title: Hamburg Days

overview: Dr Ethan Winter is one of the most gifted pathologists of his generation. He possesses an extraordinary analytical mind, capable of impeccable deductive reasoning which perfectly complements DI Lauren Bell, a meticulous, no-nonsense detective who is as driven as Winter when working on a case. Together they make a formidable team, as Winter's genius and insight into the victims is invaluable to Bell and her murder squad detectives. Yet Winter is harbouring a secret. The unsolved murder of someone close to him still haunts his every move, and he's intent on unofficially investigating the death to bring the murderer to justice.
title: Winter

overview: The Heat sees ten ambitious chefs travel to Barcelona, working under multi Michelin Star award-winning chef Jean-Christophe Novelli, who is opening an exclusive summer restaurant at the glamorous Port Vell Marina and on a mission to find the next rising star. But this isn't just a straight-forward cooking competition - each day when the kitchen service is over, the cameras keep rolling because when you're living, working and competing with one another, there is no escaping The Heat. Viewers can expect post shift dates, staff nights out and more - blending both their professional and personal lives will see tempers simmer, steam and boil, in and outside of the kitchen. These young hopefuls will quickly realise that no-one's place is secure in this fierce culinary contest, as they consistently battle it out in a bid to climb the kitchen ranks. Promotions, demotions, power plays, sackings and shock decisions throughout the series are sure to keep the contenders on their toes - every service is a chance to soar or sink.
title: The Heat

overview: A mysterious housekeeper named Mrs. Miracle gently uses a touch of Christmas magic to heal hearts, mend families, and bring love and hope back into people's lives.
title: Debbie Macomber's Mrs. Miracle

overview: Twelve-year-old Shay, an outcast in his family and at school, discovers his father Yaki's secret affair and begins blackmailing him, turning the family dynamics upside down. Yaki, a self-absorbed aspiring author, scrambles to protect his secret while Shay revels in his newfound power. Their escalating feud takes a dark turn when Shay enlists the help of a sinister neighbor who happens to also be the local pedophile, and Yaki involves an ex-detective to unmask the blackmailer. As their schemes spiral out of control, the fractured family faces trying consequences, culminating in a desperate father-son alliance to save their youngest sibling and salvage what's left of their lives.
title: Little Fucker

overview: Parents Anna and Sergey discover they're raising someone else's child: seven years ago, during IVF, doctors switched the embryos of two women. Anna decides to learn more about her biological daughter, who lives with another family.
title: Родная

overview: Ambitious and goal-oriented Sofia Likhacheva is used to keeping everything under control. She works as a crime reporter and enjoys conducting her own investigations. Sonya's personal life is also going well. Her fiancé Nikolai is a major businessman, the owner of a construction company, and they are scheduled to get married very soon. But Nikolai suddenly calls off the wedding and announces that he has met the woman of his dreams. This chance meeting with nurse Victoria seems suspicious to Likhacheva, but the fiancé does not want to hear that the meeting was set up and that his new acquaintance is after his money. Then Sofia decides to find out more about her rival, and during the investigation she learns suspicious facts from Vika's past.
title: Брошенная невеста

overview: Find out what the story is in Balamory with Miss Hoolie and the gang.
title: Balamory

overview: A woman is found murdered in the home of a notorious womanizer, restaurateur Lebedev. The investigation is led by Kira Avdeeva, who has a score of her own to settle with the womanizers: her lover just dumped her, publicly insulting her as they parted. It seems obvious that Lebedev is the culprit. But it soon emerges that his son disappeared on the evening of the murder. As Kira unravels the case, she realizes it is directly related to her own personal tragedy...
title: Роковой мужчина

overview: In Belouralsk, a grandiose construction project for a chemical plant and a satellite city has been announced. The city's power is divided between the local crime boss, Uma, and the corrupt head of the criminal investigation department, Mamonov. As the city undergoes significant changes, they engage in a criminal war, each seeking to gain full control over the construction and its billions of dollars in funding.
title: Враги

overview: Rita inherited an old bracelet from her mother, which simply fell from the hand of a dead woman, but during her lifetime she never took it off. The girl put on the bracelet and realized that now she can hear the voices of the dead, or rather, their cries for help, and also move in time, just for a day, but this is enough for her to have time to prevent someone's death. Rita quickly realizes that the bracelet cannot be removed and there is no escape from the strange gift. Then she gets a job at the morgue to be closer to those who need her help.
title: Я отменяю смерть

overview: Terra Alta is a place of wild beauty, where the scars of the Civil War still bleed. A peaceful territory until the brutal murder of Francisco and Rosa Adell, patriarchs of the wealthiest and most powerful family in the area, shocks everyone. This event forces Melchor Marín, one of the agents in charge of the investigation, to relive his dark, complex, and forgotten past. Politics, ambition, family, money, sex, religion, history…and revenge. A crime that will change the lives of everyone in Terra Alta.
title: Terra alta

overview: Mina Settembre is a social worker constantly searching for solutions to other people's problems. Her love life is always precarious, torn between her affection for Claudio, her ex-husband, and her passion for Domenico, a charming gynecologist. Her family is also in tatters, between a cynical and spiteful mother and a recently deceased father who kept a painful truth from her. But despite it all, Mina never loses her smile or the strength to help everyone.
title: Mina Settembre

overview: On the day of her grand wedding, Wen Yueqian personally witnessed her father being wrongfully executed before her eyes. Later, on her wedding night, she walked into the bridal chamber only to find her husband in an illicit affair with another woman. When she confronted him, instead of receiving an explanation, she was brutally murdered and thrown off a cliff. Miraculously, Wen Yueqian survived the fall, and alongside her, Xiao Jin, unwilling to meet his end, was also resurrected. From that moment on, their fates became intertwined.
title: Reborn from the Ashes
